title: Nutty Uruguayan Beef Tacos
description: A halal-friendly Uruguayan dish featuring air-fried beef, served in scallop shells with hard taco shells on the side, this recipe is a unique twist on traditional tacos.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, diced onion, minced garlic, chopped walnuts, ground cumin, and smoked paprika, mixing well with your hands until just combined.
Form the beef mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter and 1/2 inch thick.
Place the patties in the air fryer basket, leaving some space between each patty to allow for even cooking.
Air-fry the beef patties for 5 minutes, then flip them over and cook for an additional 4 minutes, or until they reach an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the beef is cooking, heat the olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the beef is done, place a patty in each scallop shell, followed by a spoonful of the warm olive oil.
Serve the scallop shells with hard taco shells on the side, allowing each guest to assemble their own tacos.
